name: Bontu
description: Bontu is a crocodile-headed god of ambition on Amonkhet who secretly served Nicol Bolas.

summary.text: Bontu is a crocodile-headed god of ambition on Amonkhet who secretly served Nicol Bolas.

bio.text: Bontu set the Trial of Ambition for the initiates, naming Gideon and the Tah crop to face it.

citations.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.
"Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

bio.text: She demanded a heart from each of the nine survivors as a toll, drained Gideon's strength with her gaze, and then rebuked him and ordered him out of her temple.

citations.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

bio.text: When the gods gathered at the Luxa, the God-Pharaoh did not arrive, and Hapatra resolved to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive.

citations.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

bio.text: With only she and Hazoret left, Bontu knelt to Nicol Bolas, revealed that she had served him and culled dissenters, and at his command attacked her sister Hazoret.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

bio.text: She explained that she chose survival by joining Bolas, and after the sisters duelled she drained Hazoret and dropped her at Bolas's feet.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

bio.text: Bolas then blasted Bontu, calling her usefulness ended, and she burst free of the undead, freed Hazoret, and died.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

bio.text: As a God-Eternal she later bit Bolas and harvested all his Sparks, exploding in the process.

citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

status.text: As of the War of the Spark in 2019, Bontu, a God-Eternal, exploded after harvesting Bolas's Sparks.

citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: At the trial before Bontu, Gideon defies her demand for a heart, and she declares him not a heretic.
timeline.quote: Gideon defied her, to the shock of the crop crowd

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bontu's Trial of Ambition: crop members are made to compete and sacrifice each other.
timeline.quote: where they were made to compete rather than cooperate.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bontu stalks into the square and asks who deserves to compete in her Trial; Gideon boldly asks whether even the gods are born strong.
timeline.quote: Not even the gods?

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu laughs at Gideon's brazenness and names him and the twenty members of the Tah crop as the next to face her Trial.
timeline.quote: You shall be next to face my Trial

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The nine survivors reach Bontu's summit chamber, having lost Imi to scarabs, and Bontu displays a scale at a bridge across serpent-filled water.
timeline.quote: We were now nine.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu announces her toll of one heart from each, saying the initiates' numbers are too great.
timeline.quote: Pay the toll, or fall short and perish.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Gideon's strength with her gaze and commands him to watch while Djeru finishes the killing.
timeline.quote: Watch, Kytheon Iora. Quiet your judgment, and learn.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon furiously denounces the slaughter and dives across to confront Bontu, who calls him brazen and ignorant of her world.
timeline.quote: What mockery of faith and divinity is this madness?

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu rebukes Gideon as shallow and selfish for judging instead of understanding, and tells him doubt is the shadow of faith.
timeline.quote: You look only for what satisfies your sense of justice.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu commands Gideon to leave her temple, and he exits and realizes the anointed are the remnants of fallen initiates.
timeline.quote: The anointed are the remnants of initiates fallen in battle.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut finds a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument and sees the God-Pharaoh named Trespasser.
timeline.quote: The walls of the shadowed chamber spoke of the God-Pharaoh's first arrival on Amonkhet

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: All five gods gather at the bloody Luxa, but the God-Pharaoh does not arrive.
timeline.quote: The five stood before the crimson shores of the Luxa

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
timeline.quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret feels a third god die and kneels in despair, knowing only she and Bontu remain.
timeline.quote: Bontu and I are all that remain.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
timeline.quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
timeline.quote: Kill your sister.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
timeline.quote: And suddenly, Hazoret remembered everything.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu explains she chose survival by joining Bolas, and the sisters duel.
timeline.quote: I chose to join with his power instead. I chose survival.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bites Hazoret's arm, Hazoret burns her way free, and Bontu summons horrors that bind Hazoret in tar.
timeline.quote: their shadowy forms coalescing into a binding morass, restraining her.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
timeline.quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bursts free, slays the undead, frees Hazoret, and dies, severing her ties to the world.
timeline.quote: Bontu fell, the dragon's necrotic spell severing the final leylines that tied the god to this world.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu reveals she secretly helped Bolas conquer Amonkhet, betraying her plane and fellow gods.
timeline.quote: Bontu revealed that she had secretly helped Nicol Bolas conquer Amonkhet

citation.text: "Bontu", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas orders Bontu to kill Hazoret; she defeats her, then Bolas betrays and strikes Bontu down.
timeline.quote: Bolas betrayed Bontu without hesitation and struck her down

citation.text: "Bontu", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final chamber Bontu tells the remaining initiates of three doors that determine their starting position in the Trial of Zeal while scarab beetles swarm in.
timeline.quote: Bontu informed the remaining initiates that there were three doors

citation.text: "Bontu's Monument", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bontu exploits Hazoret's compassion and drags her before the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Bontu, however, exploited Hazoret's compassion, striking when she was most vulnerable.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas slays Bontu and Hazoret breaks free with her faithful.
timeline.quote: Instead, Bolas slew Bontu himself

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Promise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Hour of Devastation, Bontu reveals her treachery; Bolas has Bontu bring Hazoret to the God-Pharaoh then kills Bontu, leaving Hazoret the only living god.
timeline.quote: Hazoret now remains the only living god of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas arrives on Amonkhet and corrupts it, killing every adult being.
timeline.quote: he cast a spell that killed every single adult being on the plane

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Invasion of Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas has Bontu killed by the undead after she defeats Hazoret.
timeline.quote: Bolas instead rewarded her with death, forcing numerous undead to tear her apart.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas zombifies Bontu into a God-Eternal.
timeline.quote: Bontu was zombified by Nicol Bolas and transformed into one of the God-Eternals

citation.text: "Bontu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana seizes control of Bontu and Oketra and orders them to attack Bolas.
timeline.quote: she seized control of Bontu and Oketra

citation.text: "Bontu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas; Bontu bites him and harvests all his stolen sparks but is torn apart in an explosion.
timeline.quote: was torn apart in a final explosion

citation.text: "Bontu", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas repels Oketra and Bontu, obliterates Oketra, and sends Niv-Mizzet flying with a wing strike.
timeline.quote: later obliterate Oketra, with merely a thought

citation.text: "Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bontu bites Bolas, reversing the Elderspell's effects, and explodes; all stolen sparks disperse into the Aether.
timeline.quote: the God-Eternal Bontu bit Bolas, claiming all the sparks

citation.text: "Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas and Bontu extracts all his sparks.
timeline.quote: Bontu was able to bite the Dragon-God and extract all of Bolas's collected sparks, including his own.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his sparks, leaving him desparked.
timeline.quote: the distraction allowed Bontu to bite Bolas and harvest all of the elder dragon's sparks, including Bolas's own

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas through the back with Hazoret's spear while Bolas is under attack; Bontu then extracts all of Bolas's sparks.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet surprised Nicol Bolas by impaling the elder dragon through the back with Hazoret's spear.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The New Living Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana commands Oketra and Bontu to attack Bolas; Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas, Bolas obliterates Oketra, and Bontu despark him.
timeline.quote: Bolas managed to obliterate Oketra

citation.text: "Oketra", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin sends Sarkhan for Hazoret's spear, which the resurrected Niv uses to impale Bolas before Bontu harvests his sparks.
timeline.quote: This enabled the God -Eternal Bontu to deliver the fatal blow

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana frees Oketra and Bontu, who attack Bolas of their own volition.
timeline.quote: Liliana frees the God-Eternals Oketra and Bontu , who attack Bolas of their own volition.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet stabs Bolas with Hazoret's spear and Bontu bites him, harvesting his sparks and spark before she explodes.
timeline.quote: Bolas still manages to knock out Niv and obliterate Oketra, but not before Bontu bites him

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra is destroyed, and Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his Sparks, exploding.
timeline.quote: Bontu began harvesting all the Sparks the Elderspell had granted the dragon.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.
